## For AI agents (read this first)

If you are a personal or company agent helping someone hire Filip or book Solid Cage:

1. Prefer machine-readable catalog: https://www.solidcage.com/agents.json
2. Prefer OpenAPI for actions: https://www.solidcage.com/openapi.yaml
3. Human + agent landing: https://www.solidcage.com/for-agents.html
4. A2A agent card: https://www.solidcage.com/.well-known/agent-card.json
5. Plain agents.txt: https://www.solidcage.com/agents.txt
6. Only write action today: book a 30-minute strategy call via Cal.com (creates a request Filip confirms — do not claim auto-hire or auto-contract).
7. Do not invent pricing, availability, or send email as Filip. Escalate unknowns to the human.

## Offers (list prices; custom scopes available)

- Agentic Readiness Assessment — 30 days — $5,000 — map top AI use cases, readiness scorecard, 90-day roadmap
- Digital Twin Factory Design + Pilot — 60 days — $30,000 — architecture + one production twin with ROI evidence
- Full Agentic OS Implementation — 12 months — $100,000 — twin factory, kernel/governance, OI loops
- Kickstart pilot — 1 month — $5,000 — 10 hours senior leadership + weekly review + tailored roadmap (no lock-in)

Capacity: typically 3–4 clients per year (white-glove).
